description.text:
Regional Championships have handed out a promo card stamped with the Regional Championships logo since the 2004-2005 season, when it was EX Deoxys' Deoxys; from 2007-2008 each card also came in a Staff copy for those who ran the events. The early cards were non-holo copies from recent expansions. Supreme Victors' Garchomp C in 2009-2010 began a run of crosshatch holofoil cards that lasted until 2014-2015, and Ancient Origins' Ace Trainer in 2015-2016 began a run of reverse holo Trainer cards.

Some seasons had a card for each round of Regionals: Jolteon in autumn, Flareon in winter and Umbreon in spring in 2012-2013, with Vaporeon for the European spring events; Bagon, Shelgon and Salamence in 2013-2014, with Leafeon in Europe; and Honedge, Doublade and Aegislash in 2014-2015. From 2023 the logo sits on the card's picture. Stellar Crown's Briar has it printed in orange on some copies and in red on others.
